subject: pharmacology
title: Androgens and Antiandrogens: Testosterone, Finasteride, Dutasteride, Flutamide, Bicalutamide, Enzalutamide

steps.tx: **Testosterone** replacement restores deficient men toward mid normal range by intramuscular esters, transdermal gels or long acting undecanoate, against symptoms plus unequivocally low morning levels on two occasions. Monitoring is haematocrit (erythrocytosis is the dose limiter), prostate surveillance by age, and fertility honesty: exogenous testosterone suppresses gonadotropins and spermatogenesis, so it contracepts the man seeking fertility, for whom clomiphene or gonadotropins substitute.
steps.say: Replace to mid normal, watch the haematocrit and prostate, and never promise fertility on testosterone itself.

left.title: Replacement essentials
points: Two low morning levels with symptoms
Gels daily or injections at intervals
Target mid normal range, not athletic ranges
Haematocrit above 54 percent: pause and review

right.title: Counselling duties
points: Transfer precautions with gels around partners and children

steps.tx: 5 alpha reductase converts testosterone to dihydrotestosterone (DHT), the prostate and scalp's preferred androgen; **finasteride** (type 2 enzyme) and **dutasteride** (types 1 and 2, longer reach) block that conversion, shrinking prostates by about a fifth over six to twelve months, improving flow and cutting retention and surgery risk, and at a fifth of the dose (finasteride 1 mg) slowing male pattern hair loss. PSA halves on therapy, a correction every screening interpretation must apply.
steps.say: Block DHT and the prostate shrinks over a year; halve the PSA before you judge it.

nodes.label: Prostate volume falls about a fifth over a year

steps.tx: **The** 5 alpha reductase inhibitors' adverse set is sexual (erectile and libido effects in single digit percentages, usually reversible) plus a teratogenic fence: crushed tablets and semen exposure matter because a male fetus under DHT blockade feminises, banning the drugs in pregnancy handling. Dutasteride's month long tail after stopping (blood donation deferred six months) exceeds finasteride's, and the disputed persistent post finasteride syndrome requires honest uncertainty in counselling rather than dismissal or endorsement.
steps.say: Sexual effects usually reverse, fetal exposure must never happen, and dutasteride lingers for months after stopping.

left.title: Finasteride
points: Type 2 reductase, daily 5 mg prostate, 1 mg hair
Sexual effects in a minority, usually reversible

right.title: Dutasteride
points: Types 1 and 2, half life about 5 weeks
Greater DHT suppression, similar prostate gains
Blood donation deferred 6 months after stopping

steps.tx: Androgen receptor blockade writes prostate cancer's history: **flutamide** and bicalutamide, non steroidal pure antagonists, block the receptor without lowering testosterone (so libido falls less while gynaecomastia and breast pain rise from unopposed oestrogen effect), used in combined androgen blockade and flare protection. Flutamide's hepatotoxicity demoted it behind bicalutamide's once daily kindness. Neither matches castration alone for survival, which is why they accompany rather than replace it.
steps.say: Bicalutamide blocks the receptor and spares testosterone; breasts pay what libido saves.

left.title: First generation antiandrogens
points: Flare protection at LHRH agonist initiation

right.title: Strategic role
points: Never survival equivalent to castration alone
Withdrawal responses occur on stopping (agonist metabolites)

steps.tx: **Enzalutamide** leads the second generation: tighter receptor binding, blocked nuclear translocation and DNA binding, no agonist activity, and survival gains across metastatic castration resistant and hormone sensitive prostate cancer, alongside abiraterone's androgen synthesis blockade as the modern pair. Its tolls are fatigue, hypertension, falls and fractures in older men, and a seizure signal (GABA antagonism) fencing it from seizure prone patients, with CYP interactions across the chart.
steps.say: Enzalutamide strangles the receptor completely; fatigue, falls and a seizure fence ride along.

nodes.label: Nuclear translocation and DNA binding blocked
Survival gains in castration resistant and sensitive disease

steps.tx: **Androgen deprivation's systemic price** is a chronic disease curriculum: hot flushes, sarcopenia and fat gain, osteoporosis and fractures (bone protection co prescribed), metabolic syndrome and cardiovascular debate, anaemia, cognitive and mood effects, and sexual extinction that relationship counselling must name. Intermittent versus continuous schedules, bone densitometry cadence and exercise prescriptions are therefore pharmacology follow through, not survivorship garnish.
steps.say: Deprivation ages the body deliberately; bones, muscle, metabolism and mood are monitored like organs on chemotherapy.

left.title: Deprivation costs
points: Bone loss: densitometry and protection therapy

right.title: Mitigation bundle
points: Calcium, vitamin D and antiresorptives by risk

steps.tx: **Anabolic androgenic steroid misuse** outside medicine borrows this lesson inverted: supraphysiological testosterone and derivatives for muscle, suppressed gonadotropins with testicular atrophy and infertility, erythrocytosis, dyslipidaemia (HDL crushed), cardiomyopathy signals, acne, gynaecomastia from aromatisation, and dependence with hypogonadal withdrawal. Harm reduction (needle exchange, haematocrit and cardiac review, fertility timelines measured in months to years after cessation) serves patients who will not accept abstinence lectures alone.
steps.say: Misused androgens suppress the axis they imitate; recovery of sperm and sense takes months after the last injection.

left.title: Misuse consequences
points: Cardiomyopathy and hepatic adenomas with oral 17 alkylated agents

right.title: Harm reduction practice
points: Non judgemental monitoring: haematocrit, lipids, pressure

steps.tx: **Female androgen pharmacology**, though smaller in this syllabus, completes the map: antiandrogens (spironolactone's receptor blockade, cyproterone, finasteride cautiously) serve hirsutism and acne with contraception mandatory beside them (feminised male fetus), while testosterone itself is licensed narrowly for postmenopausal hypoactive desire in some jurisdictions. The receptor does not care which clinic prescribes its blockers; the teratogenic fence is identical in all of them.
steps.say: Antiandrogens in women demand contraception beside them; the fetal fence follows the receptor everywhere.

nodes.label: Hirsutism or acne with androgen excess assessed
Judge at 6 months: hair cycles are slow
